metadata.description: Cyber-Physical Flow Diagram of a drinking water treatment facility including intake, coagulation/flocculation, sedimentation, filtration, disinfection, chemical post-treatment, storage, and waste disposal processes with associated SCADA/ICS infrastructure

elements.name: Water Source
elements.description: External source of raw water (river, lake, reservoir, or aquifer)

elements.name: Landfill
elements.description: External waste disposal site for treatment plant waste including sediment and filter residue

elements.name: Water Distribution Network
elements.description: External municipal water distribution infrastructure delivering treated water to end users

elements.name: Onsite Human Plant Operator(s)
elements.description: Human operators physically present at the facility who interact with both physical processes and digital control systems

elements.name: Electric Utility Provider
elements.description: External electrical power provider supplying energy to the treatment facility

elements.name: Offsite Human Plant Operator(s)
elements.description: Remote human operators who monitor and control facility operations via SCADA system from external locations

elements.name: Org Intranet
elements.description: Internal organizational network providing connectivity for business operations and potentially SCADA communications

elements.name: Internet
elements.description: External public internet providing remote access and external connectivity

elements.name: Drinking Water Treatment Facility
elements.description: Primary facility perimeter trust boundary with both physical security (fencing, access control) and cyber security controls

elements.name: Post-treatment shed
elements.description: Physically secured enclosure for post-treatment chemical storage and dosing equipment

elements.name: Electrical shed
elements.description: Physically secured enclosure for main electrical distribution equipment

elements.name: Coagulant/Flocculant
elements.description: Chemical storage for coagulation and flocculation agents (e.g., alum, ferric chloride, polymers)

elements.name: Sediment
elements.description: Accumulated sediment and settled solids from sedimentation process

elements.name: Chemical Disinfectant
elements.description: Chemical storage for disinfection agents (e.g., chlorine, chloramine, UV)

elements.name: Post Chemical
elements.description: Chemical storage for post-treatment agents (e.g., pH adjustment, corrosion control, fluoride)

elements.name: Water Storage
elements.description: Treated water storage tanks/reservoirs providing supply buffering and pressure stabilization

elements.name: Intake
elements.description: Water intake process with screens, gates, and flow control; monitored and controlled by RTU sensors and PLC actuators

elements.name: Coagulation/Flocculation
elements.description: Chemical coagulation and flocculation process to destabilize and aggregate suspended particles; controlled by PLC-operated mixers and dosing pumps

elements.name: Sedimentation
elements.description: Gravity settling process for floc removal; monitored by RTU sensors and controlled by PLC-operated clarifiers and sludge scrapers

elements.name: Filtration
elements.description: Multi-media filtration process for fine particle and microorganism removal; controlled by PLC-operated filters and backwash systems

elements.name: Disinfection
elements.description: Chemical/UV disinfection process for pathogen inactivation; controlled by PLC-operated dosing systems and UV lamps

elements.name: Chemical Posttreatment
elements.description: Post-treatment chemical addition for pH adjustment, corrosion control, and fluoridation; controlled by PLC-operated dosing systems

elements.name: Waste collection and disposal
elements.description: Waste management process collecting sediment and filter residue for disposal at external landfill

elements.name: Coagulation/Flocculation Tank
elements.description: Physical tank infrastructure for coagulation and flocculation processes

elements.name: Sedimentation Tank
elements.description: Physical basin infrastructure for gravity settling and sludge collection

elements.name: Filtration Tank
elements.description: Physical tank infrastructure housing multi-layer filter media

elements.name: Disinfection Tank
elements.description: Physical tank infrastructure for chemical/UV disinfection contact

elements.name: Storage Pump
elements.description: Mechanical pump infrastructure for transferring treated water to distribution network

elements.name: RTU Sensors (Level, flow, turbidity, temp, conductivity, pH)
elements.description: Remote Terminal Unit sensors at intake monitoring water level, flow rate, turbidity, temperature, conductivity, and pH

elements.name: PLC Actuators (gates, screens, pumps)
elements.description: Programmable Logic Controller actuators controlling intake gates, screens, and pumps

elements.name: PLC Actuators (mixers, dosing pumps, valves)
elements.description: PLC actuators controlling coagulation/flocculation mixers, chemical dosing pumps, and flow control valves

elements.name: RTU Sensors (pH, turbidity, streaming current)
elements.description: RTU sensors monitoring coagulation/flocculation process pH, turbidity, and streaming current for coagulant dose optimization

elements.name: RTU Sensors (Sludge blanket, turbidity, flow)
elements.description: RTU sensors monitoring sedimentation sludge blanket level, clarified water turbidity, and flow rates

elements.name: PLC Actuators (clarifiers, sludge scrapers, tube settlers)
elements.description: PLC actuators controlling clarifier operations, sludge scraper mechanisms, and tube settler systems

elements.name: RTU Sensors (Turbidity, ΔP, flow, particle)
elements.description: RTU sensors monitoring filter effluent turbidity, differential pressure across filter media, flow rates, and particle counts

elements.name: PLC Actuators (filters, media, backwash)
elements.description: PLC actuators controlling filter operations, media management, and automated backwash cycles

elements.name: RTU Sensors (Chlorine, ORP, UV, pH, flow)
elements.description: RTU sensors monitoring chlorine residual, oxidation-reduction potential (ORP), UV intensity, pH, and flow for disinfection control

elements.name: PLC Actuators (Feed pumps, UV lamps, dosing valves)
elements.description: PLC actuators controlling disinfectant feed pumps, UV lamp intensity, and chemical dosing valves

elements.name: PLC Actuators (Feed pumps, dosing valves)
elements.description: PLC actuators controlling post-treatment chemical feed pumps and dosing valves for pH adjustment and corrosion control

elements.name: RTU Sensors
elements.description: RTU sensors monitoring post-treatment water quality parameters

elements.name: Main Power Distribution Panel
elements.description: Primary electrical distribution panel receiving power from utility and distributing to facility equipment

elements.name: SCADA Computer/HMI
elements.description: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition computer with Human-Machine Interface for facility monitoring and control

elements.name: Internet Link/Firewall
elements.description: Network security device providing firewall protection and internet connectivity for remote access
